description: Given a latitude/longitude in the United States, return every TIGER/Line geography containing it in one call — state, county, census tract, block group, 2020 block, ZCTA, place, county subdivision, school districts, urban area, PUMA and tribal area — each with its GEOID. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH when you have a coordinate and need the geography stack around it.

layers.description: Optional explicit layer names to probe instead of the default set. Names must match tigerweb_list_layers exactly.

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (negative in the US)

name: tigerweb_geography_at_point
title: Tigerweb Geography At Point
